title: Separate support choices from sign choices in real phase searches
summary: For an order-three action on real quadratic phases on the full binary label space, the binary averaging projection splits invariant and noninvariant parts.
content: For an order-three action on real quadratic phases on the full binary label space, the binary averaging projection splits invariant and noninvariant parts. In the stated characteristic-three norm formula, support depends on the noninvariant component and surviving signs on the invariant component. Enumerate support choices first and solve remaining sign constraints linearly.
whenToUse: Searching real quadratic phases under the stated order-three action by separating support from signs.
limitations: The decomposition uses the stated binary averaging action and characteristic-three norm formula. It is not asserted for arbitrary phase families or group actions.
